# Foundations

Every scope answers the same five questions. This is the answer that sets each scope's values; open a scope for all five, its tokens and its specimen.

| Scope | Values | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Typography](./typography.md) | Large | Large body text is easy on the eyes. |
| [Color](./color.md) | Balanced | A calm, balanced palette. |
| [Spacing](./spacing.md) | Spacious | Room around the text helps reading. |
| [Shape](./shape.md) | Rounded | Rounded corners feel friendly. |
| [Elevation](./elevation.md) | Soft | Soft shadows suit warm paper. |
| [Motion](./motion.md) | Moderate | Moderate speed feels calm. |
| [Iconography](./iconography.md) | Match the text | Icons match the text size. |
| [Theming](./theming.md) | Light and dark | Light and dark ship as standard; dark helps night reading. |
| [Accessibility](./accessibility.md) | Touch size | Readers are often on phones. |
| [Naming](./naming.md) | Lowercase words in paths | Lowercase paths read the same everywhere. |
| [Voice and tone](./voice.md) | Conversational | Talk to one reader, like a good editor. |
| [Components](./components.md) | Only when the meaning changes | Pages stay calm when a component changes only with its meaning. |
